procedure.title: Batch Route-File Refactoring
procedure.step: Classify the file: heavy / medium / light / namespace. Heavy = contains getMsg + showToast + getCsrfToken + safeFetch. Medium = contains a subset. Light = no boilerplate. Namespace = exports public API.

Add ERPBootstrap.require at the top of the IIFE body:
const [guard] = ERPBootstrap.require("guard");
Replace all boilerplate function bodies with guard.* calls using the delegation map:
Delete the inlined boilerplate function declarations that are now unused.
Ensure the IIFE has try/catch wrapping the entire body, with console.error("[moduleName]", e).
Run eslint + tsc --noEmit to verify no regressions.

procedure.title: Namespace Module Refactoring
procedure.step: Identify all symbols exported on the window/global namespace (e.g., window.TaskUtils = { ... }).
For each exported method, determine if it duplicates guard/utils functionality.
Leave unique (non-duplicated) methods unchanged.
Test that all callers of the namespace module still work.

procedure.title: Post-Refactor Verification Checklist
procedure.step: Confirm guard, utils, bootstrap scripts are loaded (defer) in the layout.
Confirm no local getMsg / showToast / getCsrfToken / safeFetch declarations remain.
Run all toast types in the browser: error, warning, success, info.
Submit a form to verify bindSubmitGuard prevents double-submit.
Verify CSRF token is attached to all axios requests.
Check that namespace module exports are unchanged (public API preserved).
Run jest + playwright tests for the affected routes.
Run eslint + tsc --noEmit with zero errors.

procedure.title: Blade Layout Integration
procedure.step: Open the target layout file (admin.blade.php, auth.blade.php, or landing.blade.php).
Locate the closing </body> tag or the existing script block.

Insert the singleton scripts in order, before any route-specific scripts:
<script src="{{ asset('js/erp-guard.js') }}" defer></script> <script src="{{ asset('js/erp-utils.js') }}" defer></script> <script src="{{ asset('js/erp-bootstrap.js') }}" defer></script>
Verify with browser DevTools that window.erpGuard, window.erpUtils, and window.ERPBootstrap are defined after page load.
